article.title: 騰訊發布Hy4，加入視覺與電腦操作；權重仍待釋出
article.title_en: Tencent releases Hy4 with vision and computer use; model weights are still planned
article.summary: 騰訊於11月4日公布Hy4，將模型擴至圖像理解及軟件操作任務。
article.summary_en: Tencent announced Hy4 on November 4 with image understanding and software-interaction capabilities.
highlights: 公司列出圖表分析，以及命令列與圖形介面操作。
公告稱模型權重及系統卡將稍後提供，不能視為已全部開源。
highlights_en: Tencent describes chart analysis and command-line/graphical interface interaction.
Weights and system cards are planned, rather than already fully released.
article.why: 使用內地AI工具的行銷團隊，可評估圖像與跨軟件任務，亦要分清託管接入和權重部署。
article.why_en: Teams using mainland AI tools can evaluate visual and software tasks while separating hosted access from weight-based deployment.
article.next_step: 先核對實際帳戶的模型版本與權限，以固定素材測試一個可復原流程。
article.next_step_en: Check the account’s model version and permissions, then test one reversible workflow with fixed assets.
article.detail: 按騰訊原公告，Hy4可處理視覺資訊，並透過命令列或圖形介面執行任務；公司提及Blender及CAD等軟件訓練。這些是供應商描述，本報未實測。公告把權重與系統卡列為稍後發布安排，與模型在產品或API中的接入屬不同事情。文章不沿用內部評測排名、幻覺率或價格優惠，也不推斷所有騰訊產品同時具備相同能力。
article.detail_en: Tencent describes visual tasks and interface interaction, mentioning Blender and CAD training. These are vendor claims, not tests by this publication. Hosted product/API access differs from the planned weights and system cards. Internal rankings, error rates and promotional pricing are omitted.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
